title: nixos/gdm: ensure environment from display-manager.service is propagated
test_wiring: No file literally named gdm.nix/gdm-*.nix exists under nixos/tests/ (confirmed via full recursive tree search at head, 73301 entries, nixos/tests/ subtree fully present through 'nixos/tests/zwave-js.nix'; grep for 'gdm' across all nixos/tests/ paths and nixos/tests/all-tests.nix content returned no dedicated gdm test). gdm IS exercised indirectly: nixos/tests/all-tests.nix line 663 `gnome = runTest ./gnome.nix;`, and nixos/tests/gnome.nix (read directly at head) sets `services.displayManager.gdm = { ... }` at line 12 and includes a subtest literally named 'Login to GNOME with GDM' (lines 69-70, 'wait for gdm to start'). This is a real, wired, indirect test exercising the gdm module -- verified by reading the actual test file content, not assumed from a path/name match.
watch_selection_basis: PR diff (`gh pr diff 523948`) only adds a new PAM stack entry (`{ name = "env-greeter"; control = "required"; modulePath = ...; settings.conffile = ...; }`) inside gdm.nix's existing `security.pam.services.*` config-block list. No mkOption/mkEnableOption/mkRenamedOptionModule/etc. declaration line is textually touched. Only the baseline `enable` option (services.displayManager.gdm.enable) was watched.
